name: task_routing
description: Tasks that a coding agent receives in this repository. Pick the cheapest capable model tier and flag tasks that need a human decision.

state_fields.task: The task text as the developer wrote it
state_fields.files_hint: Optional: files or areas the task names

tier.instructions: Which model tier can do this task well at the lowest cost?

criteria.local: A small local model, because the task is mechanical: a rename, a format fix, a typo, a one-line config change, or a lookup with one clear answer.
criteria.mid: A mid-tier model, because the task is routine work with a clear specification: a CRUD endpoint, a test for known behavior, or a change in a few files that follows an existing pattern.
criteria.frontier: A frontier model, because the task needs design judgment, cross-cutting debugging, an unclear root cause, security-critical design or a large refactor.

needs_human.instructions: Must a human decide something before an agent starts this task?

criteria.true: Yes, the task needs a product or business decision, credentials, spending approval, a legal call, or it has an unclear goal.
criteria.false: No, the task has a clear goal and an agent can start without asking a person.
